thread:
maria: FYI i'm starting the cloud project for project-firebreak in az-west2. need VNet scaffold + GPU quota runbook. planning kickoff now, will hand off network and quota tasks.
jonah: thumbs. do we have a preferred CIDR range? want to avoid overlapping with existing shared-services (10.10.0.0/16)
lia: propose 10.88.0.0/16 for project-firebreak; split into /24 per AZ: 10.88.0.0/24, 10.88.1.0/24, 10.88.2.0/24. Keep 10.88.254.0/24 reserved for shared infra (bastion, jumpbox).
samir: note on cost: NAT gateway per-AZ is $$$ if we create one each. recommend NAT pooling behind transit hub or use egress proxy instances for initial stage. we can prototype with 1 autoscaled NAT instance + failover to cloud NAT.
maria: good call. can we do prefix-based NAT or use a single managed NAT? ops-team prefers managed NAT for simplicity.
lia: managed NAT is fine. we'll add flow logs to the egress subnet and S3 export for couple weeks.
jonah: GPU quota ask: we'll request 8x A100 (40GB) to start, soft limit 32 per-region. Who will file the quota ticket?
samir: i'll file. need the project billing id and projected qps. also we should request cpus/ram quotas for GPU nodes: 64 CPUs, 512GB mem as cushion.
maria: i've created the project id: firebreak-az-west2-01. billing profile is linked. please tag the quota ticket with "firebreak" and include justification: training + inference workloads.
deploy-bot: Terraform plan for network scaffold:
```
module "vnet" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/terraform//modules/vnet"
  name   = "firebreak-vnet"
  cidr   = "10.88.0.0/16"
  subnets = ["10.88.0.0/24","10.88.1.0/24","10.88.2.0/24","10.88.254.0/24"]
  tags = { project = "firebreak" owner = "maria" }
}
```
lia: will add route table entries: - route all 0.0.0.0/0 via nat-gw - route db subnet to shared-services via peering - explicit deny to known-bad ip ranges via NVA
jonah: need to add service endpoints for storage and keyvault. also ensure KMS (HSM) is whitelisted.
samir: SES/ServiceLimits ticket #CLD-4521 opened for GPUs + vCPU. ETA 3 business days.
maria: also verifying whether the region supports A100 availability zones; cloud console shows limited capacity in az-west2-a. we should request AZ reservation or be prepared to fallback to az-west1 for burst.
lia: plan for AZ-replication: we will deploy control plane across 3 AZs, but GPU pools can be in 2 AZs only if capacity limited. set affinity policy to prefer AZ-a then AZ-b.
jonah: routing question — do we create peering to shared-services or go via transit hub? transit hub preferred for future scale.
samir: transit hub initial cost estimate:
- hub appliance (managed): $300/mo
- per-AZ attachments: $20/mo
- expected NAT egress: ~ $0.06/GB depending on egress
Estimate month1 ~ $1.2k with 4TB transfer and 8 GPU nodes. we'll refine after runbook.
maria: action items:
- lia: own VNet terraform + preflight (CIDR, NACLs, flow logs) — due EOD +2
- samir: submit GPU + vCPU quota tickets, cost estimate + TAG policy — due EOD +1
- jonah: prep bootstrap playbook for GPU nodepool provisioning + SSH access rules — due EOD +2
- maria: create infra-handoff doc and schedule handoff call with security + platform — created calendar invite
lia: sharing a quick snippet for subnet tags and NVA placement:
```
resource "azurerm_subnet" "gpu" {
  name           = "gpu-subnet"
  resource_group = azurerm_resource_group.rg.name
  virtual_network_name = azurerm_virtual_network.vnet.name
  address_prefixes = ["10.88.1.0/24"]
  service_endpoints = ["Microsoft.Storage"]
  delegation {
    name = "aks_delegation"
    service_delegation {
      name = "Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters"
    }
  }
  tags = {
    Workload = "gpu"
    Owner    = "jonah"
  }
}
```
jonah: note for nodepools: taints + tolerations for GPU workloads, and enable accelerate networking. also add automatic kubelet config to cap pod density.
maria: handoff checklist (short):
- CIDR allocation confirmed
- NAT design agreed (managed NAT + plan for pooling)
- Quota tickets submitted
- Tags and cost center assigned
- Peering / transit hub decision logged
- Compliance review queued
samir: i've attached the quota ticket link in CLD-4521 and added projected numbers in the ticket body. will update when cloud support approves.
maria: ok. lia, can you run the terraform plan in staging and paste the diff here when ready? i'll do the security review and then we can merge to main.
deploy-bot: plan completed in staging; no destructive changes. run id: run-2026-05-03-09-12
lia: plan output looks clean, pushing to merge request. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/314
jonah: i'll start drafting nodepool bootstrap playbook now, will call out kubelet flags and GPU driver install steps.
maria: perfect. thanks team — i'll close this thread after handoff meeting. :white_check_mark:"
